data.name: Ghallab
data.gender_notes: Ghallab is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root gh-l-b, meaning 'to overcome, to conquer'. In Islamic history, Ghallab was the title of several victorious Muslim leaders. The name Ghallab carries the meaning “Victorious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ghallab usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes triumph over adversity and personal struggle.
data.etymology: Ghallab belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victorious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ghallab total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: غلب
in_arabic.meaning: الغالب على كل شيء، القوي، المهيمن
in_arabic.long_meaning: غلب هو اسم مشتق من الفعل غالب، والذي يعني التغلب على الشيء أو قهره. يدل الاسم على القوة والسلطة، وغالبًا ما يُستخدم لوصف الله تعالى في الإسلام، حيث يعتبر الغالب على كل شيء، القوي، المهيمن على جميع الأشياء. ورد ذكر اسم الله الغالب في القرآن الكريم في عدة آيات، منها قوله تعالى: 'ولله عز وجل، وهو الغالب على أمره'.

in_urdu.name: غلب
in_urdu.meaning: وہ جو سب پر غالب ہے، طاقتور، مضبوط
in_urdu.long_meaning: غلب ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے وہ جو سب پر غالب ہے، یا طاقتور۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں اہم سمجھا جاتا ہے کیونکہ یہ اللہ تعالی کی طاقت اور قدرت کی یاد دلاتا ہے۔ غلب نام کا استعمال مسلم معاشرے میں عام ہے، خاص طور پر جنوبی ایشیا میں جہاں اردو بولی جاتی ہے۔ یہ نام بطور عام استعمال ہوتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: घल्ब
in_hindi.meaning: जो सब पर हावी है, शक्तिशाली, मजबूत
in_hindi.long_meaning: घल्ब एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है जो सब पर हावी है या शक्तिशाली। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में महत्वपूर्ण माना जाता है क्योंकि यह अल्लाह की शक्ति और प्रभुत्व की याद दिलाता है। घल्ब नाम का उपयोग हिंदुस्तान में मुस्लिम समुदाय में आम है, जहां यह नाम बच्चों के लिए चुना जाता है।

in_pashto.name: غلب
in_pashto.meaning: هغه څوک چې په هر څه غالب دی، طاقتور، مضبوط
in_pashto.long_meaning: غلب د عربي نوم څخه اخیستل شوی دی چې معنی یې هغه څوک چې په هر څه غالب دی یا طاقتور. دا نوم د اسلامي تقويم په اړه مهم دی ځکه چې دا د الله تعالی قدرت او طاقت یادوي. غلب نوم استعمال په افغان او پښتون ټولنه کې عام دی.

in_english.name: Ghallab
in_english.meaning: One who dominates all things, powerful, strong
in_english.long_meaning: Ghallab is an Arabic name derived from the root 'gh-l-b', which means to dominate or overcome. The name signifies power, strength, and dominance. In Islamic tradition, Ghallab is considered one of the attributes of Allah, emphasizing His power and control over all things. The name Ghallab appears in the Quran, highlighting Allah's dominance and authority. As a given name, Ghallab is used across various Muslim cultures to signify strength, resilience, and divine favor.

historical_references.reference: Al-Ghazali's autobiography 'Al-Munqidh min al-Dalal' mentions an episode in which he is given the name 'Ghallab' by a Sufi master during a period of spiritual turmoil.
historical_references.context: Al-Ghazali (1058-1111 CE) was a prominent Islamic scholar, philosopher, and theologian who underwent a major spiritual crisis and wrote 'Al-Munqidh min al-Dalal' (Deliverance from Error) to document his journey back to faith and religious certainty. In this work, he recounts a pivotal moment of meeting a Sufi master during a period of turmoil who gives him the name 'Ghallab', meaning 'conqueror', to help him regain his faith and strength.

historical_references.reference: Islamic general and military commander Salah al-Din Yusuf, known as Saladin, adds 'Ghallab' to his name after defeating the Crusaders in the Battle of Hattin in 1187 CE.
historical_references.context: Saladin (1137-1193 CE) was an influential Islamic military leader and sultan who gained renown for his victories against the Crusaders. After his decisive victory over the Crusaders in the Battle of Hattin, he adopted the name 'Ghallab', meaning 'conqueror', to reflect his military prowess and success in restoring Islamic rule in the region.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Ghallab' has historical significance in the Islamic world, as it was the title given to the great military commander Al-Mansur Al-Ghallab who conquered Egypt in the 7th century AD. Today, the name is explored in various modern contexts across different platforms. On Reddit, users discuss Islamic history, military conquests, and the life of Al-Mansur Al-Ghallab in various threads. Instagram sees an appreciation for Islamic arts, particularly calligraphy, with many artists using the name 'Ghallab' in their works as a nod to the historical significance of the name. Finally, on Twitter, the name 'Ghallab' is used in the context of Sufism, with many Sufi communities and followers using the name as a term of endearment or as a reminder of the spiritual conquest that comes with the Sufi path.
